sticky is the best indication that the fruit
is ripe.  Durian is generally eaten fresh or
made into desserts such as milk shakes, ice
cream, or custard.  In Indonesia, fermented
durian is wrapped in palm leaves and
served as a popular side dish called
“tempoya.”  The fruit also is mixed with
rice and sugar to make a dessert called
“lempog.” In addition, durian seeds can
be roasted or cut into slices and fried in
